# `twoFingerDrag`

Drag two fingers together, side by side, in device pixels (element-bounds units). Dragged vertically this is the two-finger shove that tilts (pitches) a map. Android only.

## Source

- Kind: class-backed
- Class: `xyz.block.trailblaze.toolcalls.commands.TwoFingerDragTrailblazeTool`

## Contract

- Visible to LLM: yes (`surface_to_llm: true`)
- Recordable: yes (`is_recordable: true`)
- Host-only: no (`requires_host: false`)

## Input schema

### Required parameters

- `x` — `Integer`
  X coordinate of the midpoint between the fingers at touch down.
- `y` — `Integer`
  Y coordinate of the midpoint between the fingers at touch down.
- `span` — `Integer`
  Distance between the two fingers, in pixels.

### Optional parameters

- `deltaX` — `Integer`
  Horizontal distance both fingers move, in pixels. Negative is left.
- `deltaY` — `Integer`
  Vertical distance both fingers move, in pixels. Negative is up.
- `angleDegrees` — `Integer`
  Angle of the line through both fingers: 0 = side by side, 90 = one above the other.
- `durationMs` — `Integer`
  How long the gesture takes, in ms. Default 600.

Returns: `string` (opaque text content)
